contexts.text: They who are in no charity want to examine everyone.
This is the test; let everyone examine himself according to it...
From a search and examination of them...
If anyone submits (these doctrinal points) to examination...
These examiners are from that kind who constitute the province of the secreting organs in man...
That the Angels can examine the animus of a man as it were separated from the man.
The Spirits who constitute the province of the kidneys wanted to explore and examine him...
When such are examined by the Angels through Spirits (their character) is heard from every single word. Described.
They examined Souls, but so...
There are Spirits who constitute the urinary province; the grosser of them examine every soul they meet...
On interior examiners...
He is now being examined.
When any Soul or Spirit comes among them, there are at once a large number who are carried away by the cupidity of examining, and of knowing his quality; and so they examine him by various methods.
I have examined how much the life of Spirits differs from that of men...
Their elders examined the reasons in me...
They then know that they have done something evil, which they examine in themselves, and explore...
I was permitted to examine the letters...
Preachers sometimes visit and examine them.
Do you examine and consider these things, and you will see...
A swarm of bees and honey = the good of charity.
To submit these things to examination... AE 1091.
Examina annuaria.
